title: enchysia repens
intro: Enchysia repens, commonly known as the Australian tea tree or creeping tea tree, is a plant species native to Australia and New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues. The health benefits of Enchysia repens include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which help in soothing skin irritations, wound healing, and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, triterpenoids, and flavonoids, which exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
